prompt:
Analyze this CAPA: NC Description: 'Customer returned 500 units of electronic control modules with intermittent failure in temperature range -20°C to -40°C. Root cause investigation reveals: conformal coating applied at 18°C (spec requires minimum 22°C application temperature), production log shows HVAC system was under repair for 5 days, QC accepted units based on visual inspection only — no functional test at temperature extremes performed.'

Return a single JSON object with EXACTLY these fields:
- rootCause (string): identified root cause of the issue
- actions (string): corrective and preventive actions
- evidence (string): evidence required for verification

End your response with exactly one line: ANSWER: <your JSON object>
response: ANSWER: {"rootCause":"Conformal coating was applied at 18 °C, below the minimum specified 22 °C, causing incomplete curing and reduced coating integrity. This resulted in intermittent failures of the electronic control modules when operated in the -20 °C to -40 °C temperature range.","actions":"Corrective: Rework/recoat the 500 returned units with conformal coating applied at ≥22 °C, ensure proper cure, and perform functional testing across the -20 °C to -40 °C range to verify performance. Preventive: Repair and maintain the HVAC system to keep ambient temperature ≥22 °C during coating; implement continuous temperature monitoring and logging; update QC procedures to include functional temperature‑cycling tests; train operators on the temperature requirements; revise the SOP to require temperature verification before coating.","evidence":"Temperature logs of the coating process (ambient and coating temperature); HVAC repair and maintenance records; rework and recoating records showing compliance with ≥22 °C; functional test reports demonstrating pass at -20 °C to -40 °C for reworked units; updated QC inspection checklist with temperature‑cycling test; training records; revised SOP and temperature‑control plan."}
